label: External change
unavailable: External change: not available to you
unconfirmedHint: Completing a task or accepting the deliverable does not confirm the external change; only reviewed evidence or a confirmed connector result does.
flagIntro: Flag this deliverable if it changes something outside the programme. It stays Unconfirmed until reviewed evidence or a confirmed connector result confirms it.
withdrawBody: Withdraw the external-change flag of this deliverable? Only an unconfirmed flag can be withdrawn.
confirmIntro: Choose reviewed (verified) evidence of this transformation. A filename-only link never confirms. A confirmation never changes.
noVerifiedEvidence: This transformation has no reviewed evidence yet.
